newsitem.title: USA: Dow rises 50 points, NYSE sets program trade curbs.
newsitem.headline: Dow rises 50 points, NYSE sets program trade curbs.

text.p: Wall Street stocks powered to session highs in afternoon trading, as the market finally began to display some options expiration-related volatility.
The Dow rose 51 points to 6710, prompting the NYSE to impose its index-arbitrage trading curbs at 1402 EDT/1802 GMT.
The blue chip rally was led by Philip Morris Cos Inc, up three to 44-5/8. Energy shares were also strong.
"This rally is tobaccos and oils," said Scott Bleier, chief investment strategist at Prime Charter Ltd. "But on the Thursday or Friday of an expiration week, everything is related to options."
